title: Leyte landings
text: U.S. Sixth Army returns to the Philippines.

title: Battle of Leyte Gulf
text: The largest naval battle of the war breaks the Japanese fleet.

title: Australians take over Bougainville
text: Australian II Corps relieves U.S. forces at Torokina.

title: Battle of Manila
text: A month of street fighting; the city is left in ruins.

title: Zamboanga landings
text: Liberation of Mindanao begins; Marine air groups move in.

title: Jolo landing
text: Army troops land on Jolo in the Sulu Archipelago.

title: Landings at Malabang and Parang
text: X Corps lands in central Mindanao.

title: Davao falls
text: The main Japanese base on Mindanao is taken.

title: Japan surrenders
text: Hostilities end; the formal signing follows on 2 September.

title: Korean War begins
text: North Korean forces cross the 38th parallel.

title: Truce talks move to Panmunjŏm
text: Negotiations resume in tents in a village on the front line.

title: Marines shift to the western front
text: 1st Marine Division takes over the line guarding the road to Seoul.

title: Bunker Hill
text: A week of fighting for Hill 122.

title: Battle of the Hook
text: Chinese assault on the Hook outpost; his log has no flights 23–29 October.
